blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At ICON block 115645618, the canonical bnUSD SCORE was active and registered Balanced Governance as its owner. The exact v1.1.2 deployed archive exposes govTransfer, which only Governance may use to move bnUSD from an arbitrary source address, and calls checkStatus before ordinary transfers. The exact v1.0.3 Governance archive has owner-only control paths, and its active owner is a single EOA. This is a direct canonical holder-control surface; upstream reserve exposure remains separate.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: TERRA-III Safety Score V9 access review

oracleRisk.summary: bnUSD loan collateral is priced on ICON through Balanced Oracle v1.3.0 (cx133c...), which Loans calls via getLastPriceInUSD. At ICON block 116171048 the debt-bearing inventory is dominated by sICX (~96.3%), which uses Band ICX/USD times the staking sICX rate under a 30-minute global staleness gate; other Band-priced collaterals match Band feeds directly, while SOL/XLM/JITOSOL use long-threshold manual external prices.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Grok Safety Score V9 wave-8 controls research
branchApplicability.rationale: ICON Balanced Loans (cx66d4..., v1.3.0) exposes per-collateral debt, liquidation ratio, locking ratio, and price lookups. At block 116171048 getTotalCollateralDebt showed twelve debt-bearing collateral markets with different oracle paths (Band vs manual external) and two liquidation-ratio settings (117.65% vs 125%). Market-specific oracle and liquidation rows are therefore required. Registered zero-debt collaterals AFSUI/HASUI/VSUI/weETH/wstETH/tBTC appear in getCollateralTokens but are omitted as inactive markets at the pinned observation.

branches.label: Balanced Loans sICX (Band ICX + staking rate)
branches.summary: ICON Balanced Loans collateral market for sICX priced through Balanced Oracle (Band Protocol path) with per-symbol liquidation ratio 117.65% and permissionless liquidate(); residual bad debt is cancellable by burning bnUSD.

feeds.provider: Band Protocol ICX/USD via Balanced Oracle + Balanced Staking sICX/ICX rate
feeds.path: ICON Band Oracle get_reference_data(ICX,USD) * Staked ICX Manager getTodayRate -> Balanced Oracle getLastPriceInUSD(sICX) -> Loans TokenUtils.getPriceInUSD

branches.fallbackBehavior: sICX has no secondary oracle failover. BalancedOracleImpl prices sICX as Staking.getTodayRate * Band ICX/USD. getPrice rejects updates older than the global last-update threshold (1,800 seconds / 30 minutes at the pinned block). Loans liquidations call getLastPriceInUSD and inherit that staleness gate.

collateralParameters.note: On-chain getLiquidationRatio=117.65% and getLockingRatio=150% (implies max LTV 66.6667%) at ICON block 116171048.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Balanced Loans liquidate(owner, amount, collateralSymbol) is permissionless when position standing is LIQUIDATE. The liquidator burns bnUSD and receives discounted collateral after liquidator and DAOfund fee slices configured per symbol.
branches.backstop: First-line backstop is open-market liquidators who burn bnUSD for discounted collateral. There is no Stability-Pool-style dedicated bnUSD backstop pool on the Loans SCORE. Residual debt after collateral is exhausted is recorded as per-collateral bad debt (DebtDB) and can later be cancelled by burning bnUSD via cancelBadDebt.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Loans operations including liquidate and borrow are gated by checkStatus()/loansOn(). Undercollateralized remainder after full collateral liquidation is written to bad debt rather than socialized across other positions; cancelBadDebt burns bnUSD to reduce that balance. No separate global shutdown cascade was observed in the Loans v1.3.0 interface beyond status gating and bad-debt accounting.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: bnUSD is natively minted on ICON at canonical SCORE cx88fd7df7ddff82f7cc735c871dc519838cb235bb. Every reviewed off-ICON deployment is a burn-mint representation settled through Balanced's xCall messaging. The ICON SCORE's live getConnectedChains inventory names the tracked Archway and Havah contracts; Archway identifies cw_xcall as the CW20 minter with no cap, while Havah exposes the expected xCall and xCallManager contracts. Those deployments now join the registered Pharos chain mappings and authored contracts instead of falling into the unmatched-label pool. The previously reviewed Base, Avalanche, Arbitrum, BSC, Optimism, and Injective routes retain their verified xCall controllers. Caveat: a separate v2 facilitator-minted Balanced Dollar exists on Sonic (0x94dc79ce9c515ba4ae4d195da8e6ab86c69bfc38) per SODAX documentation and the coin's reserve review; it is not part of DefiLlama stablecoin id 204 and remains outside this ICON-hub route inventory pending a coordinated series and supply-netting review.
